name: Crow
body:
Crow
CR 1/3

XP 135
N Tiny animal
Init +3; Senses low-light vision; Perception +10

DEFENSE

AC 15, touch 15, flat-footed 12 (+3 Dex, +2 size)
hp 4 (1d8)
Fort +2, Ref +5, Will +2

OFFENSE

Speed 10 ft., fly 40 ft (average)
Melee 2 talons +3 (1d4-3), bite -2 (1d3-3)
Space 2-1/2 ft.; Reach 0 ft.

STATISTICS

STR 4, Dex 16, Con 10, Int 2, Wis 14, Cha 7
BAB +1; CMB +1 ; CMD 9
Feats Weapon Finesse
Skills Fly +7, Perception +10; Racial modifiers +4 Perception

ECOLOGY

Environment any land
Organization solitary, pair, murder (3-12), or mob (13-50)

Related to ravens and rooks, crows are considered by many sages as more intelligent than other bird species sharing a common ancestor with crows. It has been shown that in some cases, some of the crow species are capable of tool use and manufacture, marking them as one of the most intelligent animals that are not primates, despite their size in comparison.

Familiar

Crows can be taken as a familiar; they grant their master a +2 bonus on Fortitude saves. Bloodlords selecting a crow as their familiar may choose to gain an optional bonus instead: they gain a +1 bonus on either Fortitude, Reflex, or Will saves – each day when the bloodlord regains their spell slots, they can choose which save the bonus is applied to for 24 hours.
